mark.does: A small cross on the inside of the wrist, printed from a carved block and then marked in.

text.what: A small cross on the inside of the wrist, printed from a carved block and then marked in.
text.story: Some of the Razzouk family's blocks are three centuries old, which makes the design older than most of the tattoo machines that now apply it.
